name: TUKABEL · Béla · Ultravysoký nervózní nosový pískot
description: Native Slovak, clear Slovak vowels and consonants with a light eastern Slovak cadence. An adult man aged thirty-five with an outrageous, very high pinched nasal falsetto. Audibly a grown male comic actor projecting a strained stage head voice, with occasional coarse mature chesty catches. Thin mosquito-like reed resonance, jittery staccato delivery and nervous sudden upward leaps. Urgent tightly packed little bursts followed by pompously certain declarations. Entirely different from a booming bass or melodic female soprano: brittle, nasal, tightly wound and sarcastic. Very exaggerated adult character acting while every word remains clear. Dry close studio recording, no background, music, effects or digital pitch shifting.
